svg.title: Scenario 6: Player Turn — Warrior Uses Potion to Heal

g.text: Scenario 6: Player Turn — Warrior Uses Potion to Heal
Scenarios 6 and 7 occur within the same executePlayerTurn() call.
Goblin (SPD 25) acts second → still stunned, skips again (Scenario 7).
This diagram focuses on the Warrior (player) phase.
Note: DefendBuff from Scenario 2 expires here (turns: 1→0).
